description:
The process starts with identifying an idea for a new product or improvement to an existing one.
The R&D team conducts initial research and feasibility studies, followed by drafting design concepts.
After selecting a promising design, a prototype is built using available materials and resources.
The prototype undergoes various tests to assess its functionality, safety, and market potential.
Feedback from the testing phase is collected, and the prototype may be refined accordingly.
If a refinement is needed, then the testing phase is reinitiated.
The process ends when the prototype is either approved for further development or discarded.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_NewProductDevelopment" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/new-product-development">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_NewProductDevelopment" name="New Product or Improvement Development" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_IdeaIdentified" name="Process started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToIdentify</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyIdea" name="Identify idea for new or improved product">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToIdentify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IdentifyToResearch</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductInitialResearch" name="Conduct initial research">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IdentifyToResearch</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ResearchToFeasibility</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductFeasibilityStudies" name="Conduct feasibility studies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ResearchToFeasibility</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeasibilityToDraft</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftDesignConcepts" name="Draft design concepts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeasibilityToDraft</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DraftToSelect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectDesign" name="Select promising design">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DraftToSelect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectToBuild</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildPrototype" name="Build prototype using available materials and resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectToBuild</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BuildToTestMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestMerge" name="Testing phase">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BuildToTestMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RefineToTestMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestMergeToFunctionality</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessFunctionality" name="Test functionality of prototype">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestMergeToFunctionality</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FunctionalityToSafety</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessSafety" name="Test safety of prototype">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FunctionalityToSafety</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SafetyToMarket</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessMarketPotential" name="Test market potential of prototype">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SafetyToMarket</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MarketToFeedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectFeedback" name="Collect feedback from testing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MarketToFeedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackToRefinementGw</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" name="Refinement needed?" default="Flow_NoRefinement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackToRefinementGw</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefinementYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoRefinement</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefinePrototype" name="Refine prototype">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RefinementYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefineToTestMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Outcome" name="Prototype approved or discarded?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoRefinement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OutcomeToApprove</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OutcomeToDiscard</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApprovePrototype" name="Approve prototype for further development">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OutcomeToApprove</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApproveToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DiscardPrototype" name="Discard prototype">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OutcomeToDiscard</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DiscardToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Approved" name="Prototype approved for further development">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApproveToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Discarded" name="Prototype discarded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DiscardToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToIdentify" sourceRef="StartEvent_IdeaIdentified" targetRef="Task_IdentifyIdea"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IdentifyToResearch" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyIdea" targetRef="Task_ConductInitialResearch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResearchToFeasibility" sourceRef="Task_ConductInitialResearch" targetRef="Task_ConductFeasibilityStudies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeasibilityToDraft" sourceRef="Task_ConductFeasibilityStudies" targetRef="Task_DraftDesignConcepts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DraftToSelect" sourceRef="Task_DraftDesignConcepts" targetRef="Task_SelectDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToBuild" sourceRef="Task_SelectDesign" targetRef="Task_BuildPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildToTestMerge" sourceRef="Task_BuildPrototype" targetRef="Gateway_TestMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefineToTestMerge" sourceRef="Task_RefinePrototype" targetRef="Gateway_TestMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestMergeToFunctionality" sourceRef="Gateway_TestMerge" targetRef="Task_AssessFunctionality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FunctionalityToSafety" sourceRef="Task_AssessFunctionality" targetRef="Task_AssessSafety"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SafetyToMarket" sourceRef="Task_AssessSafety" targetRef="Task_AssessMarketPotential"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MarketToFeedback" sourceRef="Task_AssessMarketPotential" targetRef="Task_CollectFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToRefinementGw" sourceRef="Task_CollectFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefinementYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" targetRef="Task_RefinePrototype">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">Refinement needed</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoRefinement" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" targetRef="Gateway_Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OutcomeToApprove" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome" targetRef="Task_ApprovePrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OutcomeToDiscard" name="Discarded" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome" targetRef="Task_DiscardPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApproveToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ApprovePrototype" targetRef="EndEvent_Approved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DiscardToEnd" sourceRef="Task_DiscardPrototype" targetRef="EndEvent_Discarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
